A '''small citadel''' was a stone citadel located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="Exile" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> one of the walls of the citadel was a mass of collapsed stone—dressed stone blocks before some tremendous force had pushed them over. [[Ben Skywalker]] found weathering on all exposed surfaces of the stones, but no sign of [[Carbon scoring/Legends|blaster scoring]], melting, or other recognizable indicators of violence.<ref name="Exile" />
